name: toolscore
description: Toolscore: test MCP servers and the tool calls your agents make. Deterministic, local, no API key.

plugins.name: toolscore
plugins.description: Correct tool calls are not enough: audit MCP servers (lint, scorecard, effect probes), turn agent traces into tool-call tests, check that an agent told the truth about what its tools did, and pin MCP servers against drift in CI.
